title: DotfilesComparisonRun
description: Two or more full-tree git SHA legs on one scenario. Metrics are written after the run. This schema is the record, not a runtime loader. Eval-protocol pin (holding test instructions constant while the feature SHA varies) is out of scope until a real run is confounded.

comparisonId.description: Stable id for this experiment. All Pino lines and cache records for the legs share it.

hypothesis.description: What metrics should be impacted by this feature (inspect pass, latency, tokens). Not a prediction of improvement.

classifications.description: Tags for dashboard query and interview rollup.

scenarioId.description: Id of a committed scenario (for example react-node-monorepo).

model.description: Default model for every leg unless a leg overrides.

metrics.description: Filled after the leg runs. Omit on the input fixture.

treeSha.description: Git commit used as the entire tree.
